$sources: IBC 2021 Sec 1604.3 and Table 1604.3 with notes a-i (member deflection limits), alpha 9 track C12
ASCE 7-22 Appendix C and its commentary CC.1.2 (storey drift and sway under wind, not mandatory)
source: IBC 2021 Sec 1604.3: member deflections within Table 1604.3; storey drift and sway by the ASCE 7-22 Appendix C commentary (SAEngine practice) under the service combination D + 0.5L + 0.6W

storeyDrift.source: SAEngine practice after ASCE 7-22 Appendix C commentary CC.1.2: storey drift under wind h/400 (the commentary names 1/600 to 1/400 in common use; ASCE 7-22 and IBC 2021 set no limit), under D + 0.5L + 0.6W

sway.source: SAEngine practice after ASCE 7-22 Appendix C commentary CC.1.2: overall sway at the top H/400 under D + 0.5L + 0.6W (no code limit)

wallPlaster.label: Exterior wall with plaster or stucco finishes
wallPlaster.source: IBC 2021 Table 1604.3: exterior walls with plaster or stucco finishes, l/360 under W

metalSheeting.label: Structural roofing or siding of formed metal sheets
metalSheeting.source: IBC 2021 Table 1604.3 note a: total load deflection of formed metal sheets <= l/60

metalRoofSecondary.label: Secondary roof member (purlin) supporting formed metal roofing
metalRoofSecondary.source: IBC 2021 Table 1604.3 note a: secondary roof members supporting formed metal roofing, live load deflection <= l/150

metalWallSecondary.label: Secondary wall member (girt) supporting formed metal siding
metalWallSecondary.source: IBC 2021 Table 1604.3 note a: secondary wall members supporting formed metal siding, design wind load deflection <= l/90

deflection.source: IBC 2021 Sec 1604.3, Table 1604.3: roof members supporting plaster or stucco ceilings l/360 (L, S or W), l/240 (D + L); non-plaster ceilings l/240, l/180; no ceiling l/180, l/120; floor members l/360 (L), l/240 (D + L); exterior walls with brittle finishes l/240, flexible finishes l/120 (W; note f permits 0.42 times the components and cladding wind, not applied: SAEngine takes the service wind); farm buildings l/180, greenhouses l/120 (D + L); note h: a cantilever's l is twice its length. The roofs' live column includes snow (S)

overturning.source: SAEngine practice: the base overturning moment at most 2/3 of the dead load resisting moment (FS 1.5), the default pack's rule kept; ASCE 7-22 and IBC 2021 cover overturning by the 0.6D combinations (Sec 2.4.1 combination 7, Sec 2.4.5 combination 10)
